config.label: Identify your own client
config.description: Identify your own client. The project's own identifier is appended, so a site can always reach a human.

config.label: Minimum milliseconds between two requests to the same site
config.description: Minimum milliseconds between two requests to the same site. Default 1000, floor 500.

config.label: Deadline for one request to a site, in milliseconds
config.description: Deadline for one request to a site, in milliseconds. Default 20000.

config.label: Retries on rate limiting and transient failures
config.description: Retries on rate limiting and transient failures. Default 3.

config.label: In-memory cache lifetime, in milliseconds
config.description: In-memory cache lifetime, in milliseconds. Default 900000. Set 0 to turn it off.

config.label: silent, error, info or debug
config.description: silent, error, info or debug. Default error. Logs go to stderr.
